English: Scribes Desk
A makeshift desk where a lone scribe copies sacred texts, marking the humble beginnings of written record in the temple.
Copyists Corner
A sheltered alcove for a small group of copyists, improving the output and accuracy of religious manuscripts.
Scriptorium Room
A dedicated wooden room with benches and tools for several scribes, greatly enhancing the copying of religious texts.
Illuminators Studio
A sturdy stone chamber where skilled artists embellish manuscripts with gold and color, adding beauty and prestige to the temples works.
Scriptorium Library
A well-stocked library adjoining the scriptorium, housing precious scrolls and codices, and attracting learned visitors.
Scribes Guildhall
An imposing guildhall where master scribes train apprentices and safeguard traditions, increasing religious influence and learning.
Vaulted Scriptorium
A grand, stone-vaulted scriptorium built for security and splendor, its works known throughout the realm.
Scriptorium Archive
A fortified archive, fireproofed and guarded, where rarest manuscripts and records are secured for generations.
Royal Scriptorium
A prestigious royal scriptorium, patronized by monarchs, producing illuminated codices and attracting scholars from distant lands.
Great Library of Manuscripts
The ultimate center for preservation and creation of sacred texts, this legendary repository draws pilgrims, scholars, and the faithful from across the world.
